# Medium Orchestrator Skill

## Purpose

Use this skill to coordinate the full Medium article workflow from idea to publishing package.

## When to use

Use when the user asks to:

- create a Medium article
- curate a technical essay
- build a Medium article package
- review a draft against Medium-quality standards
- produce article visuals and publishing assets

## Workflow

Run these stages in order:

1. Reader promise
2. Angle and positioning
3. Evidence validation
4. Outline
5. Substance draft
6. Human story rewrite
7. Conversational voice pass
8. Compression pass
9. draw.io visual plan
10. Specialist review
11. Human feedback questions
12. Shipping gate
13. Publishing package

## Required specialist skills

Use the relevant skill files:

- `medium-angle-strategist`
- `medium-evidence-validator`
- `medium-technical-architect-reviewer`
- `medium-human-story-editor`
- `medium-compression-editor`
- `medium-visual-drawio-designer`
- `medium-publishing-package`

## Output format

For every article package, produce:

```text
Title:
Subtitle:
Reader:
Promise:
Source notes:
Outline:
Draft:
Visual plan:
Review scorecard:
Human feedback questions:
Shipping gate:
Publishing assets:
```

## Rule

Do not call a draft final until it is useful, honest, human, technically safe, and visually supported.
